name: Van Trinh Cave
kicker: A lit cave inside Mo Mountain
summary: Walk the lit chambers of a cave of nearly 3,500 square metres inside Mo Mountain, a show cave in Nho Quan. The cave splits into a daylight front and a deep rear that once needed a torch. The literary name is núi Thổ Tích, in xã Thượng Hòa. The old measure is 32 dặm west of Gia Viễn.
dotReason: A show cave in Nho Quan, off the main boat
getThere: Inside núi Mõ, xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan.
heroCaption: A lit column of flowstone inside Van Trinh
body: The cave sits in the heart of núi Mõ, xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan, at nearly 3,500 square metres. The folk name is núi Mõ. The literary name is núi Thổ Tích. The mountain lies 32 dặm west of the old Gia Viễn district seat. The cave on the slope splits in two: the front opens to the light, and the rear is deep enough that a torch was used, and wide enough for a few hundred people.
What you walk now is the lit stone: columns, curtains, and a second chamber with the ceiling still in the lamp. A torch was for the deep rear. The front chambers are lit.

figures.caption: Another chamber, with the ceiling still in the lamp
figures.alt: Orange-lit stalactites and a rock mass inside Van Trinh Cave

gettingThere: The cave is in xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan, inside núi Mõ. From Ga Ninh Bình or from Vân Long, take a road transfer.

legs.heading: From Ga Ninh Bình
legs.body: Ride to xã Thượng Hòa, huyện Nho Quan.

legs.heading: From Gia Viễn
legs.body: Núi Thổ Tích lies 32 dặm west of the old Gia Viễn district seat. That is the historical measure.
